Contract ManageProductCatalogCRUDService::createProductCatalog(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		pc: ProductCatalog = ProductCatalog.allInstance()->any(p|p.Id = id),
		isSuccess: Boolean = true
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		if pc.oclIsUndefined() = true 
		then let newPc: ProductCatalog in
		newPc.oclIsNew() and
		ProductCatalog.allInstance()->includes(newPc) and
		newPc.Id = id and
		newPc.Name = name and
		result = isSuccess 
		else result = isSuccess 
		endif 
}
